providers.name: TenderLedger

pricing.plansText: Starter: £99/month or £990/year. Pro: £249/month or £2,490/year. Enterprise: custom. Monthly plans have no annual lock-in; annual billing saves two months.
pricing.seatDetail: Enterprise includes multi-user team access. Included users on Starter and Pro and any additional-seat price are not publicly stated.
pricing.vatDetail: VAT treatment is not publicly stated on the reviewed pricing page.
pricing.trialDetail: 14-day Starter or Pro trial; cancel anytime. Card requirement is not publicly stated.

keywordAlerts.detail: Users can define a market using sectors, regions, value bands and keywords, then receive saved-search alerts and daily briefs. Starter allows up to five saved searches and alerts; Pro makes them unlimited.

semanticAiMatching.detail: The provider advertises AI-powered summaries, bid/no-bid qualification support and an opportunity qualification score, but the reviewed pages do not explicitly establish semantic alert matching.

buyerProfiles.detail: Buyer intelligence covers procurement rhythm, category behaviour, award outcomes and buyer-focused analysis; buyer tracking is listed from Pro and a compact buyer profile is exposed through the gated MCP service.

supplierProfiles.detail: Supplier intelligence includes recent winners, market share, supplier comparison and compact competitor profiles, but tracking and full supplier intelligence are plan- or access-limited.

renewalSignals.detail: Pro includes renewal signals, likely re-tenders and a 90-day radar derived from published start dates, durations and extension options. The provider describes each re-tender window as an estimate linked to the award source.

similarContracts.detail: The provider says each open tender has its history attached, including the incumbent and award record, and combines opportunity, buyer and award context in one view.

buyerDocuments.detail: The reviewed first-party pages did not establish a library of buyer plans, strategies, minutes, budgets or other buyer-authored documents beyond procurement notices.

buyerRequirements.detail: AI summaries and qualification are advertised, but the reviewed pages did not establish structured extraction of participation conditions, certifications, policies or evaluation criteria.

requirementsPlanning.detail: Bid/no-bid qualification support is advertised, but no requirements-gap, readiness-action or evidence-planning workflow was established on the reviewed pages.

awardHistory.detail: Historical award data includes award notices, contract values, winning suppliers, incumbents and buyer information, filterable by sector, buyer or supplier.

frameworks.detail: The intelligence pages say framework call-offs and DPS activity are represented in buyer and award patterns, but the reviewed pages do not establish a complete dedicated framework-discovery module.

competitorTracking.detail: Pro includes competitor, incumbent and buyer tracking; the product also supports supplier comparisons and alerts for competitor wins.

exportsApi.detail: Enterprise includes custom exports and integrations. A gated MCP/REST service exposes capped structured JSON tools; production keys and higher quotas require access.

collaboration.detail: Enterprise includes multi-user access, while Pro includes saved-market Slack alerts that can route signals into a configured team channel. Public seat counts and task-assignment workflow are not stated.

bidWriting.detail: The provider explicitly states that TenderLedger is not bid-writing software.

explicitPortals.detail: Named as one of five official UK sources monitored and ingested hourly.
Named as one of five official UK sources monitored and ingested hourly.
Named as one of five official UK sources monitored and ingested hourly.
Named as one of five official UK sources monitored and ingested hourly.
Named as one of five official UK sources monitored and ingested hourly.

otherCoverageClaims.claim: The provider says the five named UK portals are ingested hourly, deduplicated and tagged, and every signal links to the source notice.

caveats: Renewal and likely re-tender windows are estimates derived from published award data, not confirmed future procurements.
The public pages establish AI summaries and qualification but do not explicitly establish semantic alert matching.
Seat counts, additional-seat prices, VAT treatment and trial card requirements are not publicly stated on the reviewed pricing page.
Competitor tracking, renewals, exports, integrations and multi-user access are tier- or access-limited.

providers.name: Tenders Direct

pricing.plansText: At the one-year billing selection shown on the provider page: Basic £1,359, Core £2,044 and Premium £2,319. The interface also offers two- and three-year billing selections; bespoke packages are available.
pricing.seatDetail: All three paid plans state unlimited users. The seven-day trial states one user. No additional-seat price is applicable on the published unlimited-user plans.
pricing.vatDetail: VAT treatment is not publicly stated beside the reviewed subscription prices.
pricing.trialDetail: Seven-day free trial. Payment-card requirement is not publicly stated.

keywordAlerts.detail: Saved bespoke search profiles automatically produce focused alerts, and the provider explicitly advertises tender alerts for search keywords. Basic has one saved search, Core five and Premium 100.

evidence.label: Tenders Direct Find a Tender guide

semanticAiMatching.detail: Profile-based matching is established: specialists review each notice, assign industry-category keywords and match opportunities to a business profile rather than relying only on CPV or raw keyword automation. The reviewed pages do not call this AI or machine learning.

evidence.label: Tenders Direct company and matching process

buyerProfiles.detail: Buyer activity can be analysed in the historical database, but the reviewed pages did not establish structured buyer profile pages.

supplierProfiles.detail: The product tracks competitor wins, awardees and market share, but the reviewed pages did not establish structured supplier or competitor profile pages.

renewalSignals.detail: Advance Tender Alerts monitor contract expiry dates and provide up to 18 months' notice of potential re-tendering opportunities. The searchable database exposes historical awards, contract durations and likely re-tender dates.

similarContracts.detail: The provider offers more than ten years of searchable notices, but the reviewed pages did not establish comparable past contracts surfaced automatically against a current notice or profile.

buyerDocuments.detail: The included FOI tool can request winning submissions, bidder rankings, pricing, buyer scoring information and pipeline/renewal details, but it is a request workflow rather than a pre-existing buyer-document library.

buyerRequirements.detail: The separate managed bid-writing service says it establishes the buyer's requirements and checks that all required information is included. The reviewed subscription pages do not establish automated structured requirements extraction.

requirementsPlanning.detail: A readiness check and separate managed bid services support capability assessment, task planning, clarifications, reviews and submission preparation, but this is not shown as a structured requirements-gap feature inside the alert subscription.

evidence.label: Tenders Direct subscriptions and readiness check

awardHistory.detail: All subscriptions include a tender database with contracts and awards; the feature page says it contains more than ten years of notices with historical award notices, previous suppliers, contract values and durations.

frameworks.detail: Framework notices may be present in the broad notice corpus, but the reviewed product pages did not establish a dedicated framework, DPS or route-to-market discovery feature.

competitorTracking.detail: Competitor Tracker identifies competitor awards, sends alerts when named competitors win work, and analyses market share and buyer activity. All three published paid plans list competitor tracking alerts.

exportsApi.detail: All three paid plans list an export function and Integrate Basic or Complete. The API feature transfers tender data to CRM or ERP systems; the provider also names Salesforce, HubSpot and Zapier as integration examples.

collaboration.detail: Opportunity Manager centralises the bid pipeline, assigns tasks, tracks stages and deadlines, and supports team collaboration. Published paid plans include unlimited users.

bidWriting.detail: Tenders Direct provides a separate managed bid-writing service that writes proposals, structures responses, checks required information and debriefs after submission. Its fee is tailored and not included in the published alert-subscription price.

explicitPortals.detail: The provider says its alerts cover Find a Tender and positions its service as combining the named national and regional sources.

evidence.label: Tenders Direct Find a Tender guide

explicitPortals.detail: The provider names Contracts Finder among the UK procurement sources its comprehensive alert service is intended to consolidate.
The provider names Public Contracts Scotland as the Scottish national source in its procurement-source guidance and positions Tenders Direct as the consolidated UK service.
The provider names Sell2Wales as the Welsh national source in its procurement-source guidance and positions Tenders Direct as the consolidated UK service.
The provider's guidance calls the Northern Ireland source eSourcing NI/eTendersNI and positions Tenders Direct as the consolidated UK service.

otherCoverageClaims.claim: The provider says it scans more than 500 sources daily and provides every UK, Ireland and OJEU opportunity, including below-threshold notices.
The Tenders Direct Guarantee says the team monitors every known public procurement portal and matches notices to the customer's business profile every day.

caveats: The subscription prices were displayed under the one-year billing selection; prices for two- and three-year commitments were not established from the rendered page.
VAT treatment and whether the trial requires a payment card are not stated beside the reviewed prices.
Matching is described as human specialist review and profile matching, not AI or machine-learning matching.
Bid writing and bid management are separately priced managed services, not included software features in the alert subscription.
The five national portals are named in provider guidance alongside a broad all-UK coverage claim; the pages reviewed do not publish a portal-by-portal ingestion register.

providers.name: TenderSignal

pricing.plansText: Free: £0 forever. Pro: £29/month or £290/year. Business: £59/month or £590/year. Annual plans are billed at ten months' equivalent, stated as a 17% saving.
pricing.seatDetail: A multi-seat Agency tier is described as coming soon. Current plan seat allowance and additional-seat pricing are not publicly stated.
pricing.vatDetail: Prices exclude VAT; UK VAT at 20% is added at checkout.
pricing.trialDetail: Every new account starts with a 14-day Pro trial with no payment card required, then keeps the Free tier.

keywordAlerts.detail: Free includes one saved keyword search on the dashboard; Pro and Business include unlimited saved keyword searches with daily email delivery. The daily digest is also personalized by sectors, regions, value and buyer type.

semanticAiMatching.detail: Pro and Business rank and explain each match with AI relevance scoring; Free does not include AI scoring. The public page also describes full AI scoring on Business.

buyerProfiles.detail: The product provides buyer filters and, on paid plans, buyer contact details, but the reviewed pages did not establish structured buyer intelligence profiles.

supplierProfiles.detail: Award history and competitor profiles are listed on Free, Pro and Business, and award history can be searched by supplier.

renewalSignals.detail: Business includes Pipeline Intelligence, which tracks award notices, contract end dates and buyer announcements to surface likely re-tenders three to twelve months before publication.

similarContracts.detail: Award history and re-tender spotting are available, but the reviewed pages did not establish comparable past contracts surfaced automatically against a notice or profile.

buyerDocuments.detail: The reviewed pages did not establish buyer plans, strategies, minutes, budgets or a buyer-authored document library beyond procurement notices.

buyerRequirements.detail: AI relevance reasoning and summaries are advertised, but the reviewed pages did not establish structured extraction of participation conditions, certifications, policies or evaluation criteria.

requirementsPlanning.detail: A bid tracker is available on Business, but the reviewed pages did not establish requirements-gap, readiness-action or evidence-planning functionality.

awardHistory.detail: All plans list award history and competitor profiles; the product allows users to see past winners and search contract award history by supplier.

frameworks.detail: Framework notices appear in the provider's examples, but the reviewed pages did not establish a dedicated framework, DPS or route-to-market discovery feature.

competitorTracking.detail: Business adds Competitor Intelligence and competitor tracking; all plans expose award history and competitor profiles, but active tracking is plan-limited.

exportsApi.detail: Business includes CSV export. The reviewed pages did not establish an API, webhook or CRM integration.

collaboration.detail: The provider explicitly says a multi-seat Agency tier is coming soon; current multi-user collaboration is therefore not established on the reviewed plans.

bidWriting.detail: The reviewed pages did not establish response drafting, an answer library, a compliance matrix or managed bid-writing support.

explicitPortals.detail: Explicitly named as a monitored source, pulled every four hours.
Explicitly named as a monitored source, pulled every four hours.
Explicitly named as a source monitored daily.
Explicitly named as a source monitored daily.
Explicitly named as a source monitored daily.
Explicitly named as a source checked nightly.

otherCoverageClaims.claim: The provider states that all plans monitor 145+ sources, including 145+ council portals, with data updated every four hours overall and NHS Atamis/council portals checked nightly.
The footer states that tender data is sourced from UK and EU public procurement portals, but no EU portal is individually named on the reviewed coverage section.

caveats: AI relevance scoring is unavailable on Free and is therefore plan-limited.
Pipeline Intelligence is Business-only and describes likely re-tenders derived from awards, end dates and announcements rather than confirmed future tenders.
CSV export is Business-only; no API or CRM integration was established on the reviewed pages.
The provider says a multi-seat Agency plan is coming soon, so current team collaboration and per-seat pricing are not established.
Source counts, corpus counts, match quality and refresh claims are provider-stated and were not independently tested in this research.

providers.name: Tracker Intelligence

pricing.plansText: Named plans are IconIQ, LogIQ, DynamIQ and AnalytIQ. The reviewed official plan pages publish feature matrices but no numeric subscription prices; users are directed to get started, request a demo or start a trial.
pricing.seatDetail: The published plan matrix shows included licence counts of 1, 3, 5 and 5 across the four plans. Additional-seat prices are not publicly stated.
pricing.vatDetail: VAT treatment is not publicly stated on the reviewed plan page.
pricing.trialDetail: Three-day free trial is advertised. Payment-card requirement is not publicly stated.

keywordAlerts.detail: Tracker sends daily tailored contract alerts from managed profiles and saved searches. Provider guidance also describes keyword-, CPV-, sector-, region-, value- and buyer-filtered alerts.

semanticAiMatching.detail: Aria Personal Insights uses AI to assess strategic fit against a supplier's capabilities, procurement history and goals and provides personalized relevance insights. Personal Insights and framework insights are available only on higher plans in the reviewed matrix.

buyerProfiles.detail: Buyer insights, buyer behavior, activity, spend, key decision makers and buyer-supplier relationships are available across intelligence modules, but depth depends on plan.

supplierProfiles.detail: Framework and spend modules connect suppliers, buyers, awards and contracts, show previous awardees and supplier success, and expose buyer-supplier associations. These intelligence modules are plan-limited.

renewalSignals.detail: Award Data provides visibility of upcoming contract and framework renewals and pipeline contracts before tender. Contract Reminders are listed across the published plan matrix.

similarContracts.detail: The Frameworks module maps call-offs back to original agreements and exposes five years of connected contract histories, awards, suppliers and buyer details. The reviewed pages do not establish general similar-contract recommendations for every notice.

buyerDocuments.detail: Tracker pages describe access to linked tender and DPS requirement documents plus pipeline and pre-market-engagement intelligence, but do not establish a standalone indexed library of buyer strategies, minutes, plans or budgets.

buyerRequirements.detail: Aria produces AI framework descriptions covering scope, lots, timelines and commercial structure and gives supplier-focused preparation guidance. The reviewed pages do not establish a full structured extraction of all participation conditions and evaluation criteria.

requirementsPlanning.detail: Aria Personal Insights gives plan-limited actionable next steps on whom to contact, what to prepare and how to position a bid; Award Data also supports advance resource planning.

awardHistory.detail: Tracker offers historical award data, previous awardees, pricing context and archive data. The overview claims 8.5 million public-sector contracts and historical data on 586,000 buyers.

frameworks.detail: Higher plans include a dedicated Frameworks module connecting more than 18,000 frameworks, 140,000 contracts, call-offs, suppliers and buyers, with expiry views, search, relevance ranking and five years of history.

competitorTracking.detail: Award Data, Spend Analysis and Frameworks expose previous awardees, competitor landscapes, supplier success and buyer-supplier associations. The deeper spend and framework functions are plan-limited.

exportsApi.detail: The Frameworks module supports data download/export. Open API is included only on the highest AnalytIQ plan in the published plan matrix.

collaboration.detail: The plan matrix includes one, three or five licences, and the provider says Contract Reminders can be shared with a team. Multi-user access is therefore plan-limited; task assignments or comments were not established.

bidWriting.detail: Aria provides summaries, qualification insights and preparation guidance, but the reviewed pages did not establish response drafting, an answer library, a compliance matrix or a managed bid-writing service.

explicitPortals.detail: Tracker says its alerts use up-to-the-minute Find a Tender Service data feeds and that the service aggregates Find a Tender notices.
Tracker says it consolidates Contracts Finder opportunities and aggregates lower-value notices from that source.
Tracker explicitly says it aggregates Public Contracts Scotland notices into its platform.
Tracker's official digital-marketing coverage guide names Sell2Wales and says Tracker aggregates all named UK national/devolved portals into one feed.
Tracker's official digital-marketing coverage guide names eTendersNI and says Tracker aggregates all named UK national/devolved portals into one feed.
A provider sector-coverage page says Tracker aggregates tenders from TED; European/Global subscription coverage is also described through OJEU data received from the European Commission.
Tracker's healthcare coverage guide identifies the Atamis Health Family portal and says Tracker pulls London healthcare tenders from the described sources into one dashboard.

otherCoverageClaims.claim: Tracker's tender-alert page says it takes information from more than 90 portals and that researchers track more than 5,000 unique sources; other current pages describe thousands of UK, European and global sources.
Standard plan coverage is stated as UK and Republic of Ireland; EU/Global coverage is an add-on on the reviewed plan pages.

caveats: No public numeric subscription prices, billing periods, additional-seat prices, VAT treatment or trial card requirement were found on the reviewed plan pages.
Feature depth varies substantially across IconIQ, LogIQ, DynamIQ and AnalytIQ; Aria Personal Insights, Frameworks, Spend Analysis and Open API are plan-limited.

The provider publishes different source-count formulations on current pages, including more than 90 portals, more than 3,000 procurement data sources and more than 5,000 unique sources; these claims were not independently reconciled or tested.
The portal evidence establishes named coverage, but the provider does not publish a complete portal-by-portal ingestion register on the reviewed plan page.
AI summaries and Personal Insights support qualification and preparation; the reviewed pages do not establish AI bid-response drafting.
